text:
sara: FYI support flagged a customer ask from EmeraldAI — they want Emerald-7B pinned in eu-west, quantized 8-bit, version 7.1, and EU-only routing. Full ask:

```
model: emerald-7b
variant: q8_0
version: 7.1
regions: eu-west (EU-only)
sla: 99.9% monthly uptime
p95 latency target: <=200ms
estimated qps: 150 sustained, 400 burst
data residency: customer data must not leave EU
start: pilot in 6 weeks
```

matt: do we have their eval prompts or perf numbers? 150 qps for a 7B q8 variant sounds optimistic.

priyanka: pinging Emerald rep for eval set + sample traffic. We also need failure tolerances — what is acceptable fallback behavior? :eyes:

kevin: infra quick note — EU capacity for q8 emerald-7b: we have a short window but would need reserved GPUs for full SLA. Hosted can do canary, but 400 burst may hit autoscale limits. Quant kernels might need tuning.

 deploy-bot: capacity-scan: eu-west nodes (A100/80GB) -> 6 free GPUs; est sustain qps ~180 for q8 on current runtime. (automated)

lina: product POV — 99.9% SLA implies Dedicated/reserved or enterprise add-on. Rollout should be canary -> staged pin -> full pin. This looks like an enterprise sale; need commercial sign-off. :thinking_face:

support: filing ticket and marking urgency — pilot in 6 weeks so timeline is tight. I'll set P1 on intake but flag commercial.

matt: also check export control / license for weights. Even "open" models sometimes have region restrictions.

priyanka: action items:
1) request eval set + golden prompts from Emerald
2) product to surface SLA/contract path
3) infra to produce reservation options + cost delta
4) eng-ml to schedule perf smoke on q8 v7.1
I'll add to intake spreadsheet and assign owners. :memo:

sara: thanks — I'll update the customer and schedule sync with Emerald + sales Tue 10:00 CET. tagging @kevin @matt

kevin: noted — starting capacity-hold proposal. If EU-only pin required then Dedicated pool mandatory.

lina: temporary backlog note: "enterprise-pin: emerald-7b eu" set to P2; will escalate to P1 if contract or commitment received.

support: ticket link: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/4321 :link:

priyanka: will post eval samples when received. closing loop here for now. :thumbsup:
